findings.description: No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest by default, risking exposure of sensitive report data.

findings.issue_category: missing bucket ACL / public access controls
findings.description: No acl is set and no public access block is configured, leaving the bucket at risk of defaulting to broader access than intended and no explicit block against public ACLs/policies.
The ledger exports bucket, which likely holds sensitive financial data, has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, so model artifacts are stored without encryption at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so operational runbook data is stored without encryption at rest.

force_destroy = true combined with no versioning allows permanent, irrecoverable data loss if the bucket is deleted, and provides no protection against accidental or malicious object overwrite/deletion.
The object is uploaded to a bucket with no default encryption and no explicit server_side_encryption specified on the object itself, so the file is stored in plaintext.
